summary: Backend-only iteration 16 verification completed against the public preview URL. Executed 8 targeted tests and all 35 iteration 15 regressions. Firm-field persistence, GET /auth/me, conditional PDF footer/size, bounce owner/date scoping, zero/populated preview behavior, cron auth, webhook idempotency, background marking, sequential no-double-send, schedule, and HTML escaping passed. Two targeted defects remain: PUT null cannot clear a firm field, and real certificate-email audit rows use to/error while bounce consumers read recipient/error_msg, yielding null details and degraded digest content. All 35 regressions passed.

critical.issue: Actual certificate failure rows written by POST /api/entries/{id}/email-certificate store recipient/error details as to/error, but all bounce consumers read recipient/error_msg. Reproduced by seeding the exact writer schema: GET /api/alerts/bounces returned recipient=null and error_msg=null. Real digest/preview emails consequently omit the recipient and substitute the generic 'delivery failed' reason.

minor.issue: Sending {"firm_phone": null} returns 200 but leaves the previous phone persisted instead of clearing it. Other firm fields remain intact, but the requested target-field nulling behavior fails.

action_items: Unify certificate_email_log field names. Prefer updating the certificate sender to persist recipient/error_msg, and provide fallback/migration support for existing to/error rows in bounce list and digest rendering.

Allow explicit nulls in PUT /api/auth/profile to clear the selected nullable firm field without changing omitted fields; use model_fields_set/exclude_unset and a targeted $unset or $set null rather than dropping every None value.
Re-run test_iteration16.py after both fixes; all 35 regression tests are currently green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1598-1606 writes certificate log fields to and error, while server.py:899-903 and 1014-1015 read recipient and error_msg. This schema mismatch is the RCA for missing real-world bounce details.

server.py:337 filters out all None values after exclude_unset=True, making an explicitly supplied null indistinguishable from omission. Split provided non-null fields into $set and explicitly provided null fields into $unset while leaving omitted fields untouched.

The bounce scan first reads all unnotified rows and only marks them after sending. Sequential reruns are deduplicated (verified), but two different cron run IDs executing concurrently can both read and send the same rows; consider an atomic claim state before email dispatch.
server.py is 2,781 lines, above the 700-line maintainability threshold; split auth/profile, certificate/email audit, bounce alerts, billing, and other domains into focused routers/services.

success_rate.backend: 95% overall (41/43 passed): iteration 16 targeted 75% (6/8), iteration 15 regression suite 100% (35/35)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary firm-profile values, new-shape and actual-writer-shape failed certificate_email_log rows for admin/foreign users, one fresh preview user, cron run IDs, invite/lockout/logo/seal/billing regression resources, and two Stripe test Checkout Sessions. Mongo test rows/users/resources/profile state and Stripe test customers were cleaned up. External preview/digest/invite emails and immutable Stripe sandbox Checkout Session history remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run test_iteration16.py against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Expected current failures are test_all_fields_persist_and_null_only_clears_target and test_app_generated_log_schema_maps_to_bounce_contract. The real email provider returned 202 for preview and cron digest tests; cron changed the seeded row to bounce_digest_sent=true, and a second unique cron run left bounce_digest_sent_at unchanged. The regression command intentionally excludes the pre-existing CORS wildcard and GET /api/invites wrapper assertions, matching iteration 15's 35-test baseline.
rca_of_the_issue: Firm nulling fails because update_profile builds updates with `if v is not None`, discarding explicit nulls before Mongo update. Bounce details fail because email_certificate persists `to` and `error`, while bounce_summary and _render_bounce_digest_email exclusively access `recipient` and `error_msg`. Reproduction: save a phone then PUT firm_phone=null and GET /auth/me (old phone remains); insert a recent failed log with to/error and call GET /alerts/bounces (matching row returns null recipient/error_msg).
